integration_note: The legacy FINAL IMM remains only to preserve recovery velocity; new FF mean comes entirely from the replacement. Whole-controller timings include this legacy update and the new predictor. Standalone predictor timing excludes the legacy recovery tracker. P0 is NumPy, P1/P0r filtering is Numba; speed comparisons concern these implementations, not intrinsic algorithm complexity.
recommendation: Do not replace FINAL IMM with either P1 or P3 on this evidence. P1 has no consistent paired gain, worsens a fast-push tail and narrows frozen-mode gain tolerance. P3 reduces pooled absolute surface-target error but worsens closed-loop force tracking and contact retention. P2 was not selected and its61-evaluation covariance fit did not converge; do not infer a GP-family upper bound.
